import html from typing import List # Example template – in real use this would be defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author_name}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_forum_post( author_name: str, title: str, body_content: str, tag_list: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a forum post as safe HTML. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Identifier of the post's creator. title : str The heading of the user's post. body_content : str The primary content of the user's post. tag_list : list[str] A sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str An XSS‑protected HTML representation of the forum post. """ # Escape all user supplied content esc_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) esc_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) esc_body = html.escape(body_content, quote=False) # Build tag spans escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Render the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=esc_author, title=esc_title, body=esc_body, tags=tags_html )
